findings.title: Preserve the tenant boundary when authorizing invoice approval
findings.explanation: The changed authorization predicate now checks only the billing-approver role. A session carrying that role for tenant A therefore satisfies canApproveInvoice for an invoice owned by tenant B. Roles do not establish membership in the invoice's tenant, so this removes the only tenant-isolation condition visible at this authorization boundary and permits cross-tenant approval. Restore the tenant comparison alongside the role check and cover both same-tenant success and cross-tenant denial.
findings.failurePath: Given session { tenantId: "tenant-a", roles: ["billing-approver"] } and an invoice with tenantId "tenant-b", session.roles.includes("billing-approver") evaluates to true, so canApproveInvoice returns true despite the tenant mismatch and the approval gate accepts the foreign invoice.
